import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_left p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g l d =>
    match l with
    | BinarySearchTree.Empty => t
    | BinarySearchTree.Node p pl c =>
      match pl with
      | BinarySearchTree.Empty => t
      | BinarySearchTree.Node x a b =>
        BinarySearchTree.Node x a
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
            (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_left (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_zigzig_shape
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree) :
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) =
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) := by
  ext y
  simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

theorem bst_zigzig_shape
    {g p x : Int} {a b c d : BinarySearchTree} :
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) →
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) := by
  intro h
  simp only [is_bst] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨hLg, hP, hDg, hD⟩
  rcases hP with ⟨hXp, hX, hCp, hC⟩
  rcases hX with ⟨hAx, hA, hBx, hB⟩

  have hxp : x < p := hXp x (by simp [view])
  have hpg : p < g := hLg p (by simp [view])

  have h_gt_p_of_gnode :
      ∀ y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d), y > p := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with (hyc | hyd) | rfl
    · exact hCp y hyc
    · have hydg : y > g := hDg y hyd
      linarith
    · linarith

  have h_gt_x_of_pnode :
      ∀ y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)), y > x := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with (hyb | hyg) | rfl
    · exact hBx y hyb
    · have hyp : y > p := h_gt_p_of_gnode y hyg
      linarith
    · linarith

  refine ⟨hAx, hA, h_gt_x_of_pnode, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hB, h_gt_p_of_gnode, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact hXp y (by simp [view, hy])
  · refine ⟨?_, hC, hDg, hD⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hLg y (by simp [view, hy])
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) :
    zigzig_postcond t (zigzig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      cases h_precond.2.1
  | Node g l d =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          cases h_precond.2.2.1
      | Node p pl c =>
          cases pl with
          | Empty =>
              cases h_precond.2.2.2
          | Node x a b =>
              unfold zigzig_postcond
              refine ⟨bst_zigzig_shape h_precond.1,
                view_zigzig_shape g p x a b c d, ?_⟩
              rfl
  -- !benchmark @end proof
